title: Music
description: Gig posters, tour posters and record promos. Some are recreations of real concerts; others are new artwork for shows that really happened.

title: Screen & Stage
description: Film posters and theatre bills, from Kubrick to the old variety houses.

title: Book Covers
description: Reimagined book covers. Orwell, Huxley and Burgess.

title: Pop Art
description: Comic-panel melodrama in the Lichtenstein manner, with alternative captions.

title: Miscellaneous
description: Tickets, pin-ups, Desperate Dan, a bit of Keith Haring, and the odds and ends that don't sit anywhere else.
